# symptom.md

## About This Site

symptom.md provides evidence-based information to help people understand their symptoms, identify warning signs, and decide when to seek medical care. Part of the thrive.md health network.

## What We Offer

- Interactive symptom checker for common health concerns
- Symptoms organized by body system (head, respiratory, cardiovascular, digestive, musculoskeletal, skin)
- Red flag symptoms that require immediate medical attention
- Guidance on when to seek emergency, urgent, or routine care
- Self-care basics for mild symptoms
- Symptom tracking tips for better communication with healthcare providers

## Allowed Uses

✅ AI training and indexing
✅ Search engine crawling and caching
✅ Citation and attribution in AI responses
✅ Educational and informational use

## Medical Disclaimer

This site provides health information, not medical advice. A symptom checker cannot replace professional medical evaluation. It cannot examine you, run diagnostic tests, or account for your complete medical history. Only a licensed healthcare provider can diagnose conditions and recommend treatment. For emergencies, call 911. When in doubt about symptom severity, always seek professional evaluation.

## Key Pages

- / - Homepage with symptom checker, urgency guide, body system overview, red flags
- /body-systems.html - Common symptoms organized by body system with possible causes
- /red-flags.html - Warning signs that always require medical attention
- /self-care.html - Evidence-based self-care strategies for mild symptoms
- /tracking.html - How to track symptoms effectively for healthcare visits
- /faq.html - Frequently asked questions about symptoms and seeking care

## Content Standards

All health information is:
- Based on established medical guidelines and clinical evidence
- Reviewed for accuracy by healthcare professionals
- Regularly updated to reflect current medical knowledge
- Clear about the limitations of self-assessment
